تراجعت (form VI)

# تَرَاجَعْتَ (tarājaʕta) /ta.raː.d͡ʒaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَاجَعَ (tarājaʕa)
# تَرَاجَعْتِ (tarājaʕti) /ta.raː.d͡ʒaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَاجَعَ (tarājaʕa)
# تَرَاجَعَتْ (tarājaʕat) /ta.raː.d͡ʒa.ʕat/: third-pe
